case.title: Northstar Components supplier and ownership review
case.question: Who owns and controls Northstar Components GmbH, what material risk indicators exist, and which conclusions are supported by the evidence?
case.executive_judgement: Northstar Components GmbH is majority-owned through a documented two-layer corporate chain. A minority holding remains traced only to a nominee company, so the ultimate beneficial owner behind that stake is unresolved. A sanctions homonym is rejected on conflicting identity attributes. A changed payment beneficiary and contradictory director records require follow-up, but neither supports an allegation of fraud, sanctions evasion or misconduct on the current evidence.
priority_collection_plan: Obtain current shareholder agreements, voting-right schedules and board appointment rights for Meridian Industrial Holdings Ltd and Northstar Components GmbH.
Obtain the beneficial ownership declaration or equivalent underlying documentation for Helix Nominees FZE.
Verify the changed payment beneficiary directly with the contractual supplier using an independently sourced contact channel.
Obtain the latest official director filing and filing history to resolve the director-status contradiction.
Re-screen all relevant natural persons after identity attributes are verified from authoritative records.

finding_rules.title: Payment beneficiary differs from contractual supplier
finding_rules.assessment: A recent invoice redirects payment from Baltic Precision Sp. z o.o. to Volna Trading LLC.
finding_rules.next_step: Verify the beneficiary change independently with Baltic Precision and inspect amendment, banking and invoice history.

finding_rules.title: Minority beneficial ownership remains unresolved
finding_rules.assessment: Helix Nominees FZE holds 30% of Northstar, but the supplied registry record does not identify the natural-person beneficial owner behind Helix.
finding_rules.next_step: Obtain beneficial ownership declaration, shareholder register and nominee/agency documentation.
